b) A box contains 120 sweets. Ali, Billy and Caleb share the sweets in the ratio 4:7:1. Work
out how many more sweets Billy receives than Ali. (4)

Add the numbers of the ratio 4:7:1 and get the total of 12.

Divide each number by 12 and multiply by 120 to get the number of sweets for each
person.

For Ali, 4/12X120 = 40 sweets.

For Billy, 7/12X120 =70 sweets.

Find the difference of 70 and 40. 70 — 40 = 30.

Therefore, Billy receives 30 more sweets than Ali.
